details.description: Kimi K2 Instruct is Moonshot AI's open-weight mixture-of-experts chat model, with 1 trillion total parameters and 32 billion activated per token across 384 experts (61 layers, MLA attention), released under a Modified MIT License. It is built for agentic tool use, coding and reasoning, running without an extended 'thinking' mode -- Moonshot's own model card describes it as 'reflex-grade' -- and it takes text-only input. Moonshot's Hugging Face card lists Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 as this checkpoint's designated 'new_version', pointing users to a newer release.
advantages: Scores 89.5% on MMLU and 81.1% on MMLU-Pro, per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 65.8% on SWE-bench Verified (agentic coding, single attempt), per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 70.6% (Avg@4) on the Tau2 retail tool-use benchmark, per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 69.6% (Avg@64) on AIME 2024 and 97.4% on MATH-500, per Moonshot's model card.
Pre-trained on 15.5 trillion tokens with the Muon optimizer with, per Moonshot, zero reported training instability.
disadvantages: Text-only: no vision/image input, per the catalog's modality and Moonshot's model card.
Runs without an extended 'thinking' mode; Moonshot describes it as a 'reflex-grade' model rather than a reasoning model.
Moonshot's own Hugging Face card lists Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 as this checkpoint's 'new_version', marking it as superseded within Moonshot's own lineup.

Moonshot's own API platform lists the matching hosted preview endpoint ('kimi-k2-0711-preview') as discontinued since May 25, 2026, directing users to the newer Kimi K3 model, per Moonshot's Model List page.
use_cases: Agentic tool-calling workflows, such as retail or customer-support agents.
General-purpose chat and instruction following without step-by-step reasoning traces.

notes: Grouped fireworks_ai and hyperbolicai URIs both point to this same original ('0711') Kimi-K2-Instruct checkpoint (128K context, matching the catalog's max_input_tokens). The catalog's max_output_tokens carries two values (16384, 131072); kept as given rather than restated as one number. Moonshot's card also reports SWE-bench Verified (agentic) as a 65.8-71.6% range depending on scaffold; used the single-attempt 65.8% figure for consistency with the model's headline number. Catalog has no deprecation_date. Moonshot's own current API docs (platform.kimi.ai/docs/models) list 'kimi-k2-0711-preview' -- the hosted counterpart of this checkpoint -- among models discontinued since May 25, 2026, recommending Kimi K3; this governs Moonshot's own first-party API only, and the open-weight checkpoint remains independently servable through the Fireworks and Hyperbolic routes this catalog target actually uses, so I did not call the model itself deprecated. No release date found stated in the card text itself.
